moments.better: 18…Nc5 stops Nxe7+. Engine line: 19.Be3 Rfc8 20.Nxe7+ Qxe7 21.Bxc5 Qxc5 22.Qe3 (−0.30).

moments.name: 19.Bxh6
moments.headline: 19.Bxh6!! A real sacrifice: White gives up material and the engine still rates it best.
points: Puts the bishop on h6 where it can be taken.
Taking is too dangerous: Black's best reply is 19…g6 20.Bxf8 Nxf8 21.Ne3 instead (the engine rates it +2.49).
Takes the pawn on h6.
19.Bxh6 wins the exchange and trades off the attacked bishop instead of losing it to …exf4.
Takes the h6 pawn and wins the exchange once the captures settle.
Black was threatening …exf4, winning a bishop. The bishop takes something with it instead.

why.title: The idea
why.text: 19.Bxh6!! offers the bishop on h6. Taking it gives White an attack worth more than the bishop.

why.title: What White gives up
why.text: 19.Bxh6 puts the bishop on h6 where it can be taken by the g7 pawn. That's a bishop on offer.

why.title: If Black takes the bishop
why.text: 19…gxh6 is met by 20.Qd2, threatening Qxh6 and mate. Then 21.Qxh6 takes the h6 pawn, and 22.Qg6+ gives check. White is still a pawn down, but the attack is worth more: White is clearly better (+2.23).

why.title: Black's best try
why.text: Black's best is to leave the bishop alone and play 19…g6. White answers 20.Bxf8, taking the rook on f8. Then 22.Nd5 threatens Nxc7, winning the queen, and 23.h4 pushes the pawn storm towards the king. White ends up a piece ahead: White is clearly better (+2.49).

why.title: Without the sacrifice
why.text: The best move without the sacrifice, 19.Be3, is clearly weaker (+0.51 against +2.49). Black answers 19…Rfc8, taking the half-open c-file. That would leave White a little better.

moments.name: 23.Nf5
moments.headline: 23.Nf5! The only good move here: every alternative is clearly worse.
points: Plants the knight on f5: a pawn defends it and no enemy pawn can chase it away.
The next best move, 23.Bh3, would drop White's winning chances from 93% to 72% (+2.63).
23.Nf5 threatens Qh8#, with mate in 1.
It threatens Qh8#, with mate in 1, so Black has to spend the next move on it.
It prepares Qh8+, with check: the knight clears the way.
Black answers 23…Ke8.

moments.name: 25…Bd7
moments.headline: 25…Bd7 is a blunder: Black's winning chances go from 8% to 0%. It allows mate in 2.
points: White answers 26.Qh7+: the queen joins the attack: it now hits 4 squares around the Black king.
Better was 25…Be8 (+6.48).
moments.better: 25…Be8 threatens …Bd4, winning a pawn, picking it up with 27…bxc3. After 26.Rh3 Be3+ 27.Nxe3 Qg7 28.Rg3 Nc4, Black is a piece down (+6.48).
